title: Mission Critical Senior Commissioning Engineers and Managers – UK and Europe
desc:
About HDR
At HDR, our employee-owners strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone is valued, respected, and encouraged to bring their authentic selves and ideas to work each day. As we integrate diversity, equity, and inclusion into everything we do, we continually reflect on the impact we make in our organisation, our communities, and the world.
Watch our story: https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story
Every role in our organisation contributes to making a positive difference. Read on to learn how you could help deliver meaningful outcomes locally and globally.
We are building a year-round talent pipeline for
Mission Critical Data Center projects
in Europe and the UK, targeting experienced
Commissioning Engineers
and
Commissioning Managers
, both freelance and permanent.
These roles are essential to ensuring that data center building services systems are designed, installed, commissioned, and operated correctly, safely, and in full compliance with relevant standards and strict mission-critical requirements. Commissioning Managers additionally provide leadership, oversight, and coordination across the entire commissioning process, working closely with project teams and key stakeholders.
If you are an experienced commissioning professional with data center or mission-critical experience and are interested in upcoming opportunities across Europe and the UK, we would like to hear from you.
Role Overview
For Commissioning Engineers
Deliver on our commitments to clients on time and to required quality levels.
Manage and carry out commissioning activities.
Validate commissioning results and ensure they meet project specifications.
Inspect existing systems to assess performance and compliance.
Conduct measurements, surveys, and technical inspections.
Provide technical advice on commissioning strategies, programmes, and scopes of work.
For Commissioning Managers
Lead the full commissioning process across complex or multi-disciplinary projects.
Coordinate the activities of commissioning engineers, subcontractors, and wider project teams.
Develop comprehensive commissioning plans, strategies, and programmes aligned with project objectives.
Oversee commissioning documentation, quality processes, and compliance standards.
Manage stakeholder expectations and act as a key point of contact for clients and contractors.
Monitor progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation measures.
Ensure robust reporting, performance tracking, and technical governance across all commissioning phases.
Additionally (Engineers And Managers)
Collaborate with colleagues to improve systems, processes, and ways of working.
Act as a technical champion in a specific area of expertise.
Represent and promote the company through marketing and client-facing activities.
Key Responsibilities
Work safely and in compliance with company health and safety policies.
Maintain a diligent, efficient, and professional approach.
Ensure technical accuracy and production of high-quality deliverables.
Work closely with main contractors to develop commissioning strategies aligned with project needs.
Adopt company project and internal management systems.
Maintain financial awareness and manage relevant project expenditure.
Attend internal and external meetings as required.
Prepare reports containing technical, commercial, and programme information.
Develop project-specific commissioning management and validation documents.
Review drawings, manuals, and technical submissions.
Produce method statements, test scripts, and related documentation.
Identify project scope changes and report them internally.
Work with multidisciplinary teams to assess progress, challenges, and costs.
Undertake hands-on commissioning work where necessary.
General Duties
Plan ahead to ensure the availability of test instrumentation.
Support the development of tender submissions.
Complete weekly timesheets accurately.
Proactively support colleagues across the business.
Preferred Qualifications
Engineering degree and/or LEED® accreditation.
Strong controls background (highly desirable).
Minimum of 4 years’ experience with mechanical, electrical, and controls systems.
For Commissioning Managers: demonstrable experience leading commissioning processes on large or complex projects.
Required Qualifications
Must be willing to travel to site-based locations as reasonably based on HDR needs
Must be an experienced engineer, either a licensed PE or a field technician with excellent understanding of MEP systems, HVAC controls, the T&B process, etc
Must have good computer skills and effective typing skills
Understanding of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Project software
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Be familiar with the organization of design documents, the preparation of the multidiscipline designs, and the delivery of the design & construction services
Strong knowledge of construction practices, systems engineering, operations fundamentals, contracting, and general business operations
Understanding of project accounting and financial management tools
Ability to prioritize and organize work; ability to work on multiple tasks concurrently
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.
Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.
